# Wedding images (folder: w)

Put your images here. The invitation uses these filenames:

- hero.jpg   — main hero image (top of page)
- story1.jpg — "How We Met"
- story2.jpg — "The First Date"
- story3.jpg — "The Proposal"
- story4.jpg — "Our Next Chapter"

Any format (jpg, png, webp) works; use the names above or update src/config.js.
